sources.entry: farmOS - Web-based farm record keeping application. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: farmOS is a web-based farm management, planning, and record-keeping application developed by a volunteer community.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes farmOS as a web-based application for farm management, planning, and record keeping. It is developed by a community of volunteers and is intended as a standard platform for farmers, developers, and researchers to build on. The README points to official documentation on farmOS.org for installing and self-hosting it. It also mentions a paid hosting option through Farmier for individual farms and organizations. The README does not list specific features, modules, or screenshots.
use_cases: building custom farm applications on a shared platform
how_to_run: See the official installation documentation at farmOS.org to install and host farmOS yourself
notable: Community-developed open platform meant to be built upon by farmers, developers, and researchers
Official documentation on farmOS.org covers self-hosting
Paid hosting option available through Farmier
Backed by many agricultural and research organizations
caveats: The README gives no detailed feature list or setup steps; installation details are only on the external farmOS.org documentation
Paid hosting is offered through Farmier for those who do not want to self-host
